_comment: Reviewed original local-vars that no op assigns on the PC port, zero-filled at entry on Dreamcast (AI-assisted). Each entry names the function, its locals and why; "assigned_elsewhere": true marks locals the original sets on other paths but reads stale on one. Anything not listed still refuses as an uninitialized read. lower_sh4_ir.py --unassigned-locals checks every listed local exists and is never assigned; build_game_cgo.py reports entries no file used. "false_locals" lists locals that start as #f instead of 0 (a stale value only ever tested for truth).

process-particles.reason: sparticle.gc: the PC port comments out the original (.mfc0 gp-0 Count) / (.mfc0 v1-29 Count) cycle-counter reads; their difference only feeds a profiling stat. Desktop reads garbage; Dreamcast reads 0.

(method find-overlapping-shapes collide-.reason: collide-shape.gc: when tlist is #f, (b! (= a0-10 #f) cfg-11 :delay (set! v1-2 #t)) jumps to cfg-11, which tests s2-0 without setting it on that path; the PS2 and desktop read whatever the register last held (the previous loop iteration's value). Dreamcast: zero at entry, then the slot keeps its value across iterations like the register.

(method update-vis-volumes level-group).reason: entity.gc:434-441: the source notes an original GOAL compiler bug. v1-10 is read inside its own assignment ((set! sv-16 (the-as process v1-10))) and sv-16 is overwritten with s0-1 on the next line, so that stale value is never used. sv-16 is also tested by (when sv-16 ...) on the path where that when was false, reading the previous iteration's stack value or, the first time, an unset one. Dreamcast: v1-10 starts 0; sv-16 starts #f, so a first iteration without a process-drawable skips the update instead of calling it on garbage.

birth-pickup-at-point.reason: collectables.gc:1381-1388: the same original compiler pattern as update-vis-volumes, once per pickup type. Each v1-N is read inside its own (set! v1-N (when sv-64 ...)) as (set! sv-192 (the-as (pointer process) v1-N)), and sv-192 is overwritten with (-> sv-64 ppointer) before any use. Dreamcast: zero at entry.
